name: Corteiz x Nike Air Max 95 SP 'Honey Blacks'
story_html: The Corteiz x Nike Air Max 95 SP 'Honey Blacks' showcases a solid black finish on a layered leather upper with tonal mesh netting surrounding the lace bed. Contrasting yellow accents land on the shoe's branding elements, which include embroidered tongue patches and a Cortiez logo on the lateral forefoot. The sneaker rests on a matching black polyurethane midsole with yellow-tinged Max Air units.
